{
  "name": "roadraven-hud",
  "version": "0.9.0",
  "description": "RoadRaven pane in Claude Code: live agents on roadmap nodes, batched UAT sign-off, and a backlog you can start or prioritise",
  "author": {
    "name": "Shuffzord",
    "url": "https://github.com/Shuffzord"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/Shuffzord/RoadRaven",
  "license": "FSL-1.1-MIT",
  "homepage": "https://shuffzord.github.io/RoadRaven/plugin-authoring.html",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "hud",
    "claude-code",
    "roadmap",
    "agents",
    "uat"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pane theme",
      "description": "follow-app mirrors the theme picked in the RoadRaven app",
      "default": "follow-app",
      "options": [
        "follow-app",
        "amber",
        "dark",
        "light",
        "moss",
        "paper",
        "slate",
        "contrast",
        "high-contrast"
      ]
    },
    "spinner": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Claude Code spinner",
      "description": "raven swaps the spinner's word for a raven verb and adds the node an agent is working on; classic leaves it as Claude Code draws it",
      "default": "classic",
      "options": [
        "classic",
        "raven"
      ]
    }
  }
}
